description: Backlink profile of a domain: domain rank (0-1000), backlinks, referring domains, main domains, IPs and subnets, nofollow and broken links, spam score, first seen, and breakdowns by link type, TLD and country, from a web link index, in one $0.048 call. Use when you need a site's link authority at a glance. A domain with no links is an answer with zeros or no counts, which is still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

target.description: A bare domain like example.com (no scheme, path or port; subdomains allowed).
